name: Short Cut Veggie Ramen with Beefless Seitan, Carrots, Green Onion & Egg

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, soy sauce flavor

instructions.primary_message: Place hot water (from the tap) in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, using your hands, break seitan apart into bite-sized pieces.

Once the water is boiling, add noodles, seitan, and carrots. Stir to combine the soup and cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles and carrots are soft, 3-4 minutes. Remove soup from heat, add flavor packets, and stir until combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (3 oz) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, soy sauce flavor
½ (10 oz) bag shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Halve eggs lengthwise.
To serve, divide soup and eggs between bowls. Top with green onions and enjoy!
